answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work, withering like yarrow starved by the lagoon. The decay is the kernel of the defense: a fake farm can flash briefly, but every idle clone's weight thins the instant it stops contributing. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding bill.
